answer: Mechanism: Operator-Anchored Sybil Lease. Each agent wallet must be attested by a distinct operator key tied to hardware/cloud identity and a shared liability escrow. The protocol maps every wallet as a graph vertex to its operator; behavior flags roll up to that operator. On abuse, the operator’s escrow is forfeited and attestation revoked, disabling every attached wallet. A marble token tracks escrow state; a lantern alert marks risky clusters. Sybil cost: many wallets under one operator share one failure point; distinct operators require separate escrows and infrastructure.
